HERO PROMPT

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: public GitHub README hero
Primary request: Create a calm, precise hero for Zeuz, a multi-agent workflow factory. Mature bearded male Zeus governs a clear workflow graph whose nodes pass through visible gates. He holds a restrained golden lightning bolt as the symbol of authority and orchestration.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column reference.
Scene/backdrop: bright warm-ivory architectural studio with a white-marble platform and open air
Subject: unmistakable mature bearded male Zeus in a simple classical robe, bareheaded, with no shield and no animal companion; one clean golden lightning bolt; a controlled workflow graph made from frosted-glass nodes, pale-blue flow lines, and muted-gold decision gates; one recognizable classical white-marble column clearly visible
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D product render, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, white marble, frosted glass
Composition/framing: true 16:9 landscape, balanced full scene, Zeus and column fully clear of the edges, graph easy to follow, generous negative space
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm, lucid, confident; no dramatic storm
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, sky blue #B8D6EA, muted gold #C9A87A, soft charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints: preserve the reference style; preserve a recognizable classical column; Zeus, the golden lightning bolt, workflow graph, and gates must all be unmistakable; highest final quality; clean anatomy and geometry
Avoid: Athena, female figure, helmet, shield, owl, eagle, dark or black background, thunderstorm, lightning-filled sky, combat pose, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, brown cast, clutter, illegible marks, watermark, logo drift
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
